question: How do i raise a repair
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Job Management > Add Job. 
Search and select the property. 
If not defaulted, select the correct contract 
Fill in any mandatory (marked with an *) or optional feilds as required. 
Select the relevant template from the Problem (contract template) drop down box.
Update repair details and access details if required.
Click search availability from the operative availability.
Select the desired appointment date / time from the available choices
Click on the "Create Job" blue button on the bottom right of the screen.

question: How do i see the repair history for a property before i raise a new repair
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Job Management > Add Job. 
Search and select the property. 
Review the property history in the displayed grid.
For more details, click on "Show Property History" on the bottom left of the section. 
For just open / completed jobs, filter the grid on using the "Complete" or "Open" buttons on the bottom right of the section.

question: How do i raise a follow-up visit for a repair
baselineResponse:
On the Main Job screen, click on Add Event > Create at the bottom of the screen.
Fill in any mandatory (marked with an *) or optional feilds as required. 
Click on the "Save Event" blue button on the bottom right of the screen.

question: How do i extend the target date of a repair
baselineResponse:
On the Main Job Detail, click and amend the Target Date field to the required date.
Populate the Extended By with your User ID
Populate the Extended On with the current Date
Populate the Extended Reason with the revelant value. 
Click on the "Save Job" blue button on the bottom right of the screen.

question: How do i add an SOR code to a repair
baselineResponse:
On the Main Job screen, click on Add Job Item.
Select the required code from the catalogue
Enter the quantity required
Click on the "Save Job Item" blue button on the bottom right of the screen.

question: How do i upload a document on a repair
baselineResponse:
On the Main Job screen, click on futher actions > upload document. 
Select the event No, Document Type
Add the document desctiption and note if reuqired. 
Choose the file
Click the "Upload" blue button on the bottom right of the section.

question: How do i assign a repair visit on the Evolving Day
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Job Management > Evolving Day > Required Configuration
Find the job you want to assign on the right hand side in the "unallocated jobs"
Right Click and drag the job over the required operatives name.
Click on the "Reassign Event" blue button on the bottom right of the section.

question: How do i reassign a repair visit to a different operative  on the Evolving Day
baselineResponse:
Locate the job in the middle grid against the original operative.
Right click and drag the job over the new operatives name. 
Click on the "Reassign Event" blue button on the bottom right of the section.

question: How do i see my cost v sales margins on a job
baselineResponse:
On the Main job screen, click into the Job Totals tab.
On the left hand side of the screen you can see the total cost and total Sales of the job. 
Below that you can see the Margin Value and Margin %

question: How do i financially complete a repair
baselineResponse:
On the Main Job Details, ensure the Job Status 1* is set to a completed status. 
Click on "CTI Job & Save" white button on the bottom right of the completion details section.

question: How do i add a template of events to a job
baselineResponse:
On the Main Job Details, click on "Apply Template"
Select the required template from the options
Click Apply
Click Yes on the confirmation message

question: How do i add template SORs to a job
baselineResponse:
On the Main Job screen, click into the events tab.
Select the required event and click on "Template Items" from the options at the bottom of the page.
Select the required template and select (tick) the items you want to add. 
Amend the quantity field if reuqired on each line
Click "Add Selected Items"

question: How do i send a job to an opertives mobile device
baselineResponse:
On the Main Job Detais, click into the events tab. 
Select the required event and click on "Send to Mobile" at bottom of the screen.
The button will update to "Remove from Mobile" and the Mobile status will update to 1.

question: How can i see all repairs with an attend on date of today
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Job Management > Events Control
Filter Date by "Attend on Date"
In the Date range, select "Today" 
Click "Search" on the bottom right of the grid.

question: How do i get a tile to appear on my dashboard
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Reports > Tile Reports
Find the tile you want to appear on your dashboard.
Click on the star on the top right of the tile
This will turn gold when favourited.
Navigate back to Home and the new tile will be displayed

question: How do i raise a purchase order with an item
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Purchase to Pay > Create / Edit Purchase Orders
Click on "Create Purchase Order"
Fill in any mandatory (marked with an *) or optional feilds as required. 
Click on "Create Purchase Order" 
Click into the PO Items tab
Click on "Add PO Item"
Select the required item and update the quantity ordered 
Click on Save Purchase Order Item.

question: How do I fully GRN a purchase order
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Purchase to Pay > Create / Edit Purchase Orders
Search for an existing purchase Order 
Click on "Book in PO" 
Click on GRN All Items on the bottom left of the screen
Select the required location to GRN the items into 
Click on Create GRN

question: How do i authorise a purchase order
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Purchase to Pay > Create / Edit Purchase Orders
Search for an existing purchase Order 
Click on "Authorise PO" on the bottom right of the screen. 
The PO Authorised Field will update to Y.

question: How do i see my compliance stats for a specific complaince task
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Compliance > Compliance Task Control
Select the relevent Compliance Task ID and click the "Search" blue button on the bottom right of the section. 
Scroll down to the "Compliance Stats" section for review.

question: How do i see all the compliance tasks at an individual property
baselineResponse:
Navigate to System Admin > Properties / Assets > Properties.
In the "search for an existing property" section, click on "Select Property"
Search for and select the revelant property from the results
At the bottom of the screen, click on "Compliance Task" and review

question: How do i find out what locations a stock item is in
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Stock Management > Stock Operations
Search for the item in the "search term" box at the top of the screen
Select the relevant record from result in the grid.
Click on the "Stock Locations" button at the bottom of the screen to review.

question: How do i see what stock is in a individual van
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Stock Management > vehicles and Stock items
Enter the details for the relevant record (via Operative ID / location or Vehicle) and click search
Select the required record from the grid of results and click on "Vehicle Stock Items" button on the bottom left of the section
Review the stock records in the grid. 
For the most recent  stock levels, click on "Deterime Stock Levels" button on the bottom left of the section.

question: How do i see a survey response
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Survey Response and select the required Survey name from the list displayed. 
Enter the Status / Response Date or job number if required, or click "search" for all records
From the results in the grid, select the relevant record and click "View"

question: How do i reset a user password
baselineResponse:
Navigate to system Admin > Security > Users
In the "search for an existing user section" enter the user details and select the relevant record from the results
go to the password settings tab and click "reset password"
Enter the new password and re-enter the new password
Click on Submit.

question: How do i add a role to a user
baselineResponse:
Navigate to System Admin > Security > Roles
In the first box, click into Users and search for the relevant user you wish to update
In the action, make sure it is "assign to"
In the Role box, search and select the role you wish to update against the user
Click on "Update Users / Roles"

question: How do i add a new record to a system default dropdown list
baselineResponse:
Navigate to System Admin > System Setup > System Defaults
In the search bar, enter the details of the default you want to update to constrain the list or scroll down until you find the record and click "Open"
Click Add on the bottom right of the section
Enter the relevant details
Click Add

question: How do i amend the price of a stock / SOR item
baselineResponse:
Navigate to System Admin > Stock / SORs > Item Details
In the Edit an existing Item box click on "Search An Existing Item"
Enter the details of the item in the search bar and select the relevant record from the list of results and click "Choose Selected Codes"
Click on the Pricing Tab and update the requested price feild. 
Click on "Save" on the bottom right of the screen.

question: How do i see all jobs created today
baselineResponse:
Navigate to Job Management > Job Control
In the Job Control Adanced Search, click on filter date by and select recorded date
In the Date Range select today
Click on Search on the bottom right of the screen and review the results in the grid.

question: How do i add an absense record for an operative
baselineResponse:
Navigate to System Admin > Operatives > Absence Details For an Operative
Search for the operative in the search bar and select the relevant record for the results 
Fill in any mandatory (marked with an *) or optional feilds as required. 
Click on "Save" at the bottom right of the screen.

question: How do i update a qualification expiry date for an operative
baselineResponse:
Navigate to System Admin > Operatives > Operatives
In the Search for an existing Operative section, enter the operative details and select the relevant record from the results
Click the "Qualifications" button at the bottom of the screen
Click on the Qualification record you want to update and amend the expiry date field
Click on "Update" and click on the "OK" confirmation message.
